articles.title: SEBI’s Credit Risk-o-Meter may make bond risks easier to compare
articles.excerpt:
The Securities and Exchange Board of India’s (SEBI) new Credit Risk-o-Meter could make it easier for retail investors to compare debt investments by translating credit ratings into six colour-coded risk categories, addressing a common difficulty in interpreting ratings assigned by different credit rating agencies.

The regulator has mandated, effective in 45 days, the meter for listed and proposed-to-be-listed non-convertible securities, commercial papers, securitised debt instruments, security receipts and structured debt or market-linked debentures, whether issued through public issues or private placements.
